title: Estimate part lookup no longer offers a part once it is inactive
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user (Admin) · 1 browser · about 10 minutes
  • Build: the Part Lifecycle QA build (no build exists yet; use the build named in the test run).
  • User: [Admin] = you, signed in with the Admin role, which by default has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete' and See Financial Data.
  • Location: [Loc-1] = the location picked in the top-bar location switcher at the start; every step runs at [Loc-1] unless it names another location.
  • Data: [Part-A] = one tracked part at [Loc-1], quantity 4, set inactive in Setup.
  • Data: [WO-1] = a work order still at the estimate stage (it shows the "Estimate" pill and its line [Line-1] reads "Needs Approval"), with no parts.
  • Names and numbers marked (e.g. …) are examples only. What must hold is the status (active or inactive), tracking, quantity and link described above.

Setup

  1. Go to Parts → Inventory, click "New Inventory Part" and fill in Description (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL ESTLOOK PART), Part Number (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-ESTLOOK-01), Category (e.g. Uncategorized), Cost (e.g. $10.00), Sell Price (e.g. $20.00); leave "Track quantities and cost of goods" on; set the default bin's Quantity to 4; click Save.
  2. [Part-A] = the part number you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-ESTLOOK-01); [Desc-A] = the description you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL ESTLOOK PART).
  3. Go to Work Orders, click "New Work Order"; in Customer click Add and create a customer (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST PL ESTLOOK Customer"); in Asset click Add and create a unit (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST-PL-ESTLOOK-UNIT"); click Create.
  4. [WO-1] = the work order number shown at the top left (e.g. S2-1234).
  5. On [WO-1] click "New Line", type Title (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST PL ESTLOOK line"), click "Save & Close". [Line-1] = that line.
  6. While [Part-A] is still active, on [Line-1] open the ⋮ menu, click "Request part" and type "ZZAUTOTEST-PL-EST" in Part Number: [Part-A] is offered. Close the dialog with × without saving.
  7. Set [Part-A] inactive: on the Active tab search [Part-A], click its row, pick Part Status "Inactive", click Save, leave the note empty and click "Deactivate" in the "Deactivate part?" confirmation.
  8. Check the setup worked: [WO-1] shows the "Estimate" pill, [Line-1] reads "Needs Approval" (do not approve it), and [Part-A] is on the Inactive tab only.
custom_steps:
1. Open [WO-1].
  2. On [Line-1] open the line's ⋮ menu and click "Request part".
  3. Type "ZZAUTOTEST-PL-EST" in Part Number.
  4. Clear Part Number and type [Desc-A].
  5. Close the dialog with ×.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 3: No row for [Part-A] is offered, neither as an inventory part nor as a "Part Library" row.
  • Step 4: Again no row for [Part-A] is offered.
  • Step 5: [Line-1] still holds no parts and [WO-1] is still an estimate.
